crime: {WITCH_NAME}'s mother once sat up sewing every button on her daughter's coat tight. "So you won't need me to fix them." By morning she was gone. Ever since, {WITCH_NAME} had known: people make sure you won't need them right before they go.
Every evening, one girl mended the prisoners' torn uniforms on the lounge sofa. She waved goodnight with her needle, never looking up from the seam.
Whenever {WITCH_NAME} grew extra arms, they tore through the back of her dress, and the girl sewed it up. It was the only help {WITCH_NAME} ever let anyone give her.
Early one evening, the girl cut two slits in the back of {WITCH_NAME}'s spare dress and began hemming them. "So it never tears again. You won't need me for it."

While the others were at the evening showers, {WITCH_NAME} came up behind the sofa and closed her hands around the girl's throat until she was still, then left her bowed over the dress in the sofa corner.

Ten minutes before lockup, the prisoners returned from the showers for their mending. Above the sofa back, they saw the girl's needle draw its thread and wave goodnight. {WITCH_NAME} stood beside the sofa, holding their mended uniforms in both hands. She handed them out and walked down the cell corridor among them, never out of their sight until lockup.

Five minutes before lockup, some went back up for the girl and found her strangled, bowed over the hemmed dress in her lap. In the trial court, the prisoners ruled she was strangled after they left her sewing, while {WITCH_NAME} walked down among them.

One prisoner turned over the new hem. Its last stitches slanted against every stitch the girl had ever put in their uniforms. They understood: the needle that waved goodnight had been drawn by a hand from {WITCH_NAME}'s back, reaching in beside a girl already dead.
fields.epitaph: A hem is sewn to hold for years. She never asked who meant to be there to see it.
fields.epithet: The girl who held on with more hands than anyone could let go of
execution: The execution stand raises a tall iron frame over a bed of iron spikes, a single bar across its top, and hangs her from the bar by her hands. She grows every arm she has and grips the bar with all of them. Iron hands pry her hands off the bar, one at a time. The last iron hand closes over her last hand, as if to hold it. Then it opens. She drops onto the spikes and lies still, every hand open.

magic.name: Many Hands
magic.text: She grows extra arms from her shoulders and back, each as deft, strong and sensitive as her own.
